summary: Verified 3 requested features: (1) Category import via .xlsx/.csv button visible in Configuración > Inventario, (2) Audit logs backend for Expenses & Income (create_audit_log fired on PUT/DELETE), (3) Auditoría tab visible for account_admin with filters, table, and expandable details. Backend and frontend integration working end-to-end.
passed: GET /api/audit returns logs with proper schema (id, user_name, action, record_type, old_data, new_data, timestamp)
POST /api/other-income + PUT /api/other-income/{id} creates 'update' audit log with old_data and new_data (verified via API)
DELETE /api/other-income/{id} creates 'delete' audit log with old_data (verified via API)
Existing sale + expense audit logs present in DB and returned by /api/audit
UI: Auditoría tab visible in Configuración for account_admin
UI: Auditoría table shows entries: Ingreso Eliminado, Ingreso Editado, Egreso Eliminado, Venta Editado (user Tricomar, correct timestamps)
UI: Filters (Tipo de Registro, Acción) and Actualizar button present, 'Ver cambios' accordion present
UI: Inventario tab shows 'Importar .xlsx/.csv' button next to 'Agregar Nueva Categoría'
